teaching_clarity.rationale: One refund makes can-versus-may concrete, then carries the distinction through scoped read, transform, disclosure denial, narrow approval, effect custody, replay, and replacement.

composition.rationale: All 72 exact beat samples preserve a clear focal hierarchy at 854 by 480; the refund, envelope, membranes, ceiling, receipts, denial record, and evidence line remain legible without paragraph cards.

motion_quality.rationale: Forty-nine timed animations use assembly, membrane stops, envelope stamping, domain crossing, receipt return, tuple mismatch, lifecycle progression, non-inheritance, and residual handoff as semantic motion.

synchronization.rationale: Twenty-four audio-derived beats end at 279.630 seconds, exactly matching the narration receipt and mux; start-middle-end sampling confirms each visual change occurs within its spoken idea.

continuity.rationale: Refund 47 and its authority envelope persist from the opening decision through grant, denial, effect, adversarial substitution, revocation, replacement, bounded evidence, and the closing residual.

pacing.rationale: The 129-word-per-minute narration alternates prediction, construction, failure, adversarial comparison, finite evidence, and payoff; fifteen low-difference diagnostics are readable explanatory holds with localized meaningful state.

voice.rationale: The 603-word script uses one concrete refund, direct questions, short definitions, and exact bounded claims; the audio-only pass contains no templated overview or unexplained opening jargon.

sound_mix.rationale: The 48-kilohertz narration-only mix has no three-second silence and measures minus 16.3 LUFS integrated, 2.9 LU range, and minus 1.5 dBTP; physical-device audition remains a release-candidate obligation.

engagement.rationale: The opening asks whether a flawless refund should run, resolves the question with a missing disclosure stamp, then pressure-tests the answer with a confused deputy, identical replay, and stronger replacement model.

accessibility.rationale: Labels, shape, position, borders, and stable endpoints duplicate color; motion contains no flash, shake, spin, or continuous zoom; all 67 captions pass timing and length audit.

claim_fidelity.rationale: Exact finite counts and the caller-ceiling result appear inside a local boundary, while authentic identity, complete mediation, concurrent revocation, secure wrappers, production adapters, open-world observation, safety, transfer, and ASI remain explicitly outside support.

non_claim: Passing the animatic records story, timing, visual mechanism, captions, and bounded experience review only; picture-and-sound lock, release candidate, independent review, publication, and evidence promotion remain ungranted.
